Anika (People Ops): Quick heads-up — Tess hits 1 year next Friday (June 4)! Want to do a small surprise. Vote pls: :seedling: for a desk plant (low mess) or :pie: for mini pies + coffee in the office. Remote folks we'll ship a care package either way. Reply with emoji or short text. Also mark if you can swing by for a 10-min surprise at 2:30pm. Please DM me addresses by Wed. No spoilers, please! (cc @Tess)

Jon: :pie: — and can we add a vegan option? Also can help pick up.

Kai: :seedling: — save me from sugar coma. can we get one that tolerates low light? :grin:

Zoe: :pie: + coffee please. i'll bring candles (fake ones).

Tess: aww thanks everyone! pls no spoilers :flushed: i'm working with a client till 2:15 so 2:30 should be ok. if i have to hop off early i'll be back fast.

Anika (People Ops): Changing plan: surprise at 2:15 so Tess can join. If you're in office, meet at the kitchenette at 2:10. Remote folks — we'll Zoom in for 2 minutes at 2:15 and ship a care package. DM me address & dietary prefs by Wed EOD. Form: https://forms.redwood.com/tess-ship (please use your company email)

BirthdayBot: Heads-up: Reminder set — 'Tess 1yr surprise' on Fri Jun 4 at 14:15. Auto DM to people who haven't submitted addresses 48h before.

Jon: I'll pick up pies. can someone cover checkout with front desk? @Facilities?

Kai: I can swing by front desk after lunch. also adding a sticky note with a goofy gif.

Zoe: :partyparrot: can't wait!

Anika (People Ops): Thanks team :heart: Please keep this thread spoiler-free. If you're remote and want to record a 10s video shoutout, send it to me by Thu.
